## Summary

- Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Changes

- List the meaningful changes.

## Help Center

- Link updated articles for every functional change, or state why this change has no user-facing behavior impact.

## Technical details

- Record decisions, assumptions, and relevant edge cases, or write None.

## How to test

1. Provide verification steps and actual results, including setup when needed.
2. Identify unrun checks and remaining limitations. For visual changes, include captured before/after evidence when available.

## Risk / impact

- Identify affected flows, compatibility or migration risks, or write None.
